text:
Jessica (CS): Quick heads-up on Littoral onboarding — seeing p95 jump from ~320ms -> ~740ms over the last 48h, and cost per 1k tokens up ~35%. Thinking we should proactively offer a compact canary + routing hedge to avoid renewal friction. Ideas?

Mark (Solutions): Can you paste the p95 trend + a few sample traces? :eyes:

Jessica (CS): Pasted the short summary below. Minimal traces attached in the onboarding ticket.

```
p95_latency: 740
avg_prompt_tokens: 420
error_rate: 0.6% (stable)
model_in_use: rw-base-3b
notes: prompt mix shifted towards longer context and many small followups
```

Suggested intervention: try `rw-compact-2-int8` as a canary (lower token cost) + routing rules that fall back to `rw-base-3b` for long prompts. Also enable prefix KV caching (30s) for the common initial prompts.

Ali (SRE): That sounds reasonable. Two cautions: 1) int8 quant can slightly shift logits — we should run a quality eval on a 1k-sample production prompt set; 2) add observability hooks (A/B labels, token-level diffs).

Mark (Solutions): I'll spin up an eval harness against their golden set. If quality delta < 1.5% (intent/fluency), proceed. Rollout plan I propose: 10% canary for 24h -> 50% for 24h -> full, with automatic rollback on error or QoQ regression.

Jessica (CS): Plan to offer Littoral an enablement call to explain the tradeoffs and walk through the console toggle. Draft customer note: "We can reduce latency and cost by ~20–30% with a compact model canary — we'll monitor quality and you can opt out any time."

opsbot: [deploy-bot] Scheduled canary job: littoral-compact-canary-2026-03-22T10:15Z (10% traffic)

Mark (Solutions): Also add a route-hedge rule: route prompts with >600 tokens to base model to protect against any regression on long-context completions.

Jessica (CS): Agreed. Add new routing snippet for the config: 

```
routing_rules:
  - if prompt_tokens > 600 -> rw-base-3b
  - else -> rw-compact-2-int8 (canary 10%)
cache:
  prefix_kv: true
  ttl_seconds: 30
monitoring:
  ab_label: littoral_compact_canary
  quality_eval_set: onboard_golden_1k
```

Ali (SRE): I'll instrument A/B logging and add token-level diffs + alert if p95 increases by >15% or quality regression >1.5%. ETA ~2 hours.

Jessica (CS): I'll message the customer with the draft and schedule the enablement call. Will capture their consent and update this thread with the eval pass/fail and canary metrics. Thanks all! :thumbsup:

Mark (Solutions): Nice — if the canary looks good we'll include an estimated monthly $ savings in the renewal pack to highlight impact.

Jessica (CS): Good call — will include cost savings and a one-pager on how routing + prefix cache works for their team.

Ali (SRE): Canary started, logs incoming. Will report p50/p95/tokens and quality delta in this thread in ~6 hours.

Jessica (CS): Perfect — keeping this thread as the single source of truth for the Littoral compact routing proposal.
